The contracting image has width t/2<1/2, hence every interior negative-to-negative transition has the same integer lift and successive differences form a geometric progression. The closing transition in either monotone orientation and first positive-to-negative transition yield the necessary inequality H_{k-1}< (5-t)t^{k-1}. For k>=5 its normalized left side exceeds 5-t by Bernoulli bounds on four terms; for k=4 attraction forces t<3/4 but H_3/t^3 >=148/27>5-t. Exact Fraction verification of the listed 4 points at a=203/5000,b=17/25 checked all four branch reductions, regularity, period, and multiplier (84/25)(16/25)^3=344064/390625<1.
